info.title: Kitchen Sink API
info.description:
A full-featured test API that exercises every OpenAPI capability supported by the docs renderer: all HTTP methods, path/query/header/cookie parameters, enums, multiple request content types, named request and response examples, file uploads, oneOf/allOf schemas, reusable components and security schemes.

## Rate Limiting

- **Free Tier**: 100 requests
- **Pro Tier**: 1000 requests
- **Enterprise Tier**: 10000 requests

tags.name: Users
tags.description: Create, read, update and delete user accounts.

tags.name: Orders
tags.description: Order management with polymorphic payment methods.

tags.name: System
tags.description: Health and monitoring endpoints (no auth required).

get.description: Returns a paginated list of users. Supports filtering, sorting, full-text search and date filtering. Demonstrates **query enums**, array parameters, header parameters, cookie parameters and a deprecated parameter.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number to fetch (1-based).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of items per page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Field to sort by.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort direction.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by account status.

parameters.name: roles
parameters.description: Filter by one or more roles (repeat the parameter: `roles=admin&roles=editor`).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free-text search across username, full name and email.

parameters.name: created_after
parameters.description: Only return users created after this timestamp.

parameters.name: include_deleted
parameters.description: Deprecated — use `status=deleted` instead.

parameters.name: X-Request-ID
parameters.description: Optional client-generated ID echoed back for request tracing.

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: Session cookie set by the login flow (cookie parameter test).

twoUsers.description: A standard successful page of results.

post.description: Creates a new user account. Accepts **three content types** (JSON, form-urlencoded and multipart) and ships **three named request examples**. Fires the `userCreated` callback if `callbackUrl` is provided.

requestBody.description: The user to create. `password` is write-only and never returned.

minimal.description: Only the fields marked as required.

admin.description: Elevated role — requires an admin bearer token.

avatar.description: Optional profile picture (PNG or JPEG, max 2 MB).

Location.description: URL of the newly created user.

example.message: Request body is not valid JSON
A user with email jane@example.com already exists

422.description: Validation failed on one or more fields.

details.issue: must be greater than or equal to 13

post.description: Sent to the `callbackUrl` provided at creation time.

options.description: CORS preflight for the `/users` collection (OPTIONS method rendering test).

get.description: Legacy search endpoint — use `GET /users?search=` instead. Tests the `deprecated` flag, a content-based parameter and parameter-level named examples.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query string.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: JSON-encoded filter object (content-based parameter test).

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Locale used for collation, with multiple named examples.

get.description: Fetches a single user. Demonstrates a **UUID path parameter**, sparse fieldsets and response links.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: UUID of the user to fetch.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include (sparse fieldset).

ReplaceUser.description: The `id` returned here can be used as `userId` in `PUT /users/{userId}`.

put.description: Full replacement of a user resource. Demonstrates an **If-Match precondition header** and a 412 response.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: UUID of the user to replace.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: ETag of the version you intend to replace (optimistic locking).

requestBody.description: The complete new state of the user. Omitted optional fields are reset to defaults.

example.message: Request body is not valid JSON

412.description: The If-Match ETag no longer matches — the resource changed.

example.message: The resource was modified by another request

patch.description: Applies a JSON merge patch. Demonstrates a **reusable requestBody component** ($ref) and the `application/merge-patch+json` content type.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: UUID of the user to patch.

example.message: status must be one of: active, suspended, pending, deleted

delete.description: Soft-deletes a user by default; pass `force=true` to permanently erase. Demonstrates a **204 No Content** response.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: UUID of the user to delete.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Permanently erase the user and all associated data (GDPR erasure).

409.description: User has open orders and cannot be deleted without force.

example.message: User has 3 open orders. Retry with force=true.

post.description: Uploads a profile picture via **multipart/form-data** with a binary file field, a caption and an enum crop mode.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: UUID of the user.

requestBody.description: The image file and optional processing instructions.

file.description: PNG, JPEG or WebP image, max 2 MB.

example.message: File is 4.8 MB; the limit is 2 MB
image/tiff is not supported. Use PNG, JPEG or WebP.

get.description: Returns the raw image bytes (binary response test).

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: UUID of the user.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Requested square size in pixels.

get.description: Returns orders for the authenticated user, filterable by status.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by order status.

parameters.name: processingStage
parameters.description: Filter by the internal order processing stage. Intentionally large enum — exercises how the docs UI lays out many allowed values.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number to fetch (1-based).

post.description: Places a new order. The `payment` field is **polymorphic (oneOf + discriminator)** — either a card payment or a PayPal payment. Each variant has its own named request example.

example.message: items must contain at least 1 entry

get.description: Fetches a single order. The response schema is composed with **allOf** (base order + status tracking fields).

parameters.name: orderId
parameters.description: Order identifier.

get.description: Public liveness probe. No authentication, no parameters — tests the *No parameters required* state and a plain-text response alongside JSON.

head.description: Same as GET /health but returns headers only (HEAD method rendering test).

get.description: Minimal untagged endpoint — tests the fallback sidebar group and an operation with no tags, no params and no auth.

bearerAuth.description: Include your token in the Authorization header: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN_HERE

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.0 with authorization-code and client-credentials flows.

username.description: Unique handle, lowercase letters, digits and underscores.

fullName.description: Display name; null if the user has not set one.

isActive.description: Whether the user can log in.

legacyId.description: Deprecated numeric ID from the v1 API.

UserCreate.description: Payload for creating or replacing a user.

password.description: At least 10 characters. Never returned in responses.

callbackUrl.description: If set, the userCreated callback is POSTed here.

OrderItem.description: A single line item in an order.

unitPrice.description: Price per unit in the order currency.

OrderWithTracking.description: An order composed via allOf: base order plus shipment tracking fields.

Error.description: Standard error envelope returned by all non-2xx responses.

PageParam.name: page
PageParam.description: Reusable page parameter (component reference test — note: referenced params may not render).

UserPatch.description: JSON merge patch — include only the fields you want to change; send null to clear a field.

clearName.description: Merge-patch semantics: null removes the value.
